subject_group: 9.2 Crew stations, control stations, and air vehicle interiors

versions.text:
Standard: Stowage provisions for required emergency equipment are furnished and arranged so that the equipment is accessible without using tools and stowage location is visible without having to move other items. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review cockpit or crew station layout drawings or digital mockups to verify stowage provisions for emergency equipment. Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in a mockup or on the air vehicle that stowage provisions are visible and accessible without having to move other items.
